4th Period.workingNow: Playtesting your MVP against the checklist: character, setting, 2 states, 1 mechanic.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: An MVP of your ROLLER mod — built from your design document pasted into SchoolAI, split across multiple JavaScript files — with a player-controlled character, a basic setting, at least 2 states, and 1 working mechanic that creates a challenge, playable and pushed to your repo by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can test my MVP against the requirements so that I know it's ready to turn in.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: I do: model playtesting against the checklist (5 min)
We do: playtest a partner's game, give one note (10 min)
You do: fix one bug from feedback, finalize (8 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your MVP link (3 min)
4th Period.connections: All week you built your MVP piece by piece: character, controls, mechanic, second state. Today someone else plays it and tells you what's missing before Sunday night. Next week you take that feedback and keep building on top of your MVP.
